flagged.title: The Nature of God and Human Life in Sikhism
flagged.reason: The video explicitly instructs students to memorize Guru Granth Sahib page 94 as the scriptural anchor for God placing His light (Jot) within all beings (which is actually Ang 349), leading students to cite the wrong scriptural source for AO1 marks.

mark_affecting.quote: and our third anchor page, Guru Granth Sahib page 94. Here, we learn that God placed his light, known as the Jot, within all created beings.

mark_affecting.quote: The Nitnem consists of five set prayers taken directly from the Guru Granth Sahib.
